### God’s Justice
Author: Dr. James Dobson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-devotions-for-parents-by-dr-james-dobson/dr-dobsons-parenting-devotional-july-24.html
Passage: Psalm 128:1
Points:
- Walking in God's ways requires cultivating a healthy fear of the Lord.
- Parents must teach children about divine justice alongside divine love.
- Unpleasant consequences for sin are real and can remain even after forgiveness.
- Recognizing personal accountability before God steers young people toward moral choices.
- Emphasizing only grace while ignoring God's righteous wrath distorts biblical truth.

### Toward a Healthy Nation
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/toward-a-healthy-nation?ga=testimonial-resources
Passage: Psalm 128:4-6
Points:
- Those who fear the Lord receive lasting personal happiness and strong family bonds.
- Raising children according to God's direction produces adults who bless civil society.
- The overall peace and strength of a nation reflect the condition of its homes.
- Parents have a limited window of time to instill godly character in the next generation.
